provenance.confirmation_status: This analysis uses the already-explored NAAMP discovery data and is not independent confirmation.

question: Can flexible species-specific responses to measured route-night environment reproduce the observed within-taxon multi-site concentration once strictly-prior physical-site history, dry-state persistence and total wet incidence are retained?
population: Exactly the 2,916-pair strictly-prior physical-site-history subset used by the principal comparator; coverage must reproduce 439 routes.
endpoint: Exactly the existing within-taxon concentration endpoint sum choose(max(k-1,0),2) over acoustically route-new taxa, with the existing conditional residualization on simulated route-new-taxon and extra-stop rainfall coefficients.

training.split: Existing deterministic SHA256 route fold A/B; every focal route is predicted only by the opposite route fold.
training.response: For each species and route-run, number of calling-positive stops out of 10.
training.minimum_information: At least 20 positive stop cells and at least 5 positive routes in the training fold; otherwise the environmental logit shift is fixed to zero.

measured_common_environment_model.family: Binomial GLM with ridge fallback if ordinary GLM is unstable.
terms: cubic B-spline of log(1 + DaysSinceRain), 4 df, fixed bounds 0..log(181)
cubic B-spline of mean route-run air temperature, 4 df, fixed bounds -10..45 C
linear interaction log(1 + DaysSinceRain) x mean temperature
measured_common_environment_model.pair_effect: For each species, compute cross-fitted predicted logit(wet route-run) minus predicted logit(dry route-run). Add this species-by-pair common environmental shift to every stop-specific anchored probability.
measured_common_environment_model.site_structure: Retain strictly-prior species x physical-SiteID probability and a=0.75 dry-state persistence exactly as in the principal comparator.
measured_common_environment_model.magnitude: Solve one pair-level common logit shift so expected total wet incidence equals observed wet incidence.

simulation.conditioning: Use the existing null-regression residual method conditioning concentration on simulated route-new-species and total extra-stop rainfall coefficients.

interpretation_rules.common_environment_supported_as_sufficie: Observed conditional residual lies within the flexible-null 95% residual interval.
interpretation_rules.residual_dependence_beyond_measured_comm: Observed conditional residual exceeds the flexible-null upper 95% residual bound.
interpretation_rules.boundary: Failure of this measured-environment null does not identify social facilitation, synchronous breeding, movement, rainfall causality or a unique mechanism; unmeasured shared environmental variables remain possible.

comparison: Report the flexible-null predicted concentration and residual alongside the existing principal linear species-response + prior-history comparator (predicted 1.3535, observed 1.6503, residual 0.2969).
forbidden_reframing: Do not call this confirmatory or preregistered relative to the original discovery endpoint.
Do not tune spline df, interaction set, information thresholds or simulation conditioning after reading the flexible-null endpoint.
Do not infer a unique lower-level mechanism from rejection.
